description:
Macro and calorie tracker – offline, no account, ad-free MacroBandit is a free and ad-free macro and calorie tracker. It works offline and without an account: all data stays on your device. Features
  • Quick entry like "200g milk 3.5" – amount detected, calories and macros calculated instantly
  • 7,140 basic foods offline from the German food database (BLS 4.0, Max Rubner-Institut)
  • Barcode scanner (zxing, no Google services) and online search – product data from Open Food Facts, on request only
  • Own foods and meal templates, applied with one tap
  • Weekly and monthly statistics, weight tracker with history
  • TDEE calculator and personal macro goals
  • Backup and restore as a file, CSV export
  • German and English, light and dark theme
The app is free software under the GNU AGPL-3.0.
